subject.title: feat: Add Anthropic server-side compaction API support

question: Should Anthropic server-side compaction be a provider-owned model parameter with defined automatic continuation behavior, or should OpenClaw expose a broader generic context-management passthrough API?
rationale: Both approaches are technically feasible, but they establish different public configuration contracts, security boundaries, and ownership for transcript continuation and usage accounting.

options.title: Provider-Owned Opt-In
options.body: Add typed Anthropic model parameters and provider-owned replay/continuation handling, keeping the capability restricted to supported direct Anthropic routes.

options.title: Generic Passthrough
options.body: Expose validated generic beta headers and context-management payloads, accepting the larger compatibility and security-review surface.

options.title: Keep Local Compaction Only
options.body: Decline native transport integration and continue using OpenClaw or registered plugin summarization providers.

recommendation.title: Provider-Owned Opt-In
recommendation.body: Add typed Anthropic model parameters and provider-owned replay/continuation handling, keeping the capability restricted to supported direct Anthropic routes.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal covers the Anthropic transport, shared compaction configuration, provider docs, and the prior product-review discussion.
